The separate32 reserve is solely standalone qualification/finite-domain comparisons, never extra solver trials/rechecks beyond12. No unused stage budget transfer.

route_gate.fail_action: do not qualify this route; independent unaffected stages continue; original live production unchanged
route_gate.direct_R: actual dX preserved; FP64 proxy and contractions; finite X/G/W/Q/Z/dR/dX plus conservative FP64 dense-overflow bound. Uncertain -> original same-candidate authoritative within counted reserve, or CERTIFICATION_FAILED. Never label finite merely because direct dR finite.
route_gate.evaluator: preserve left pad/positions/group; fallback original complete microbatch for both true/new values, never singleton near-tie
route_gate.timing_selection: same GPU only, all gates PASS, median candidate<median reference AND max candidate<min reference for TIMING_SEPARATED; overlapping ranges -> SPEED_UNRESOLVED, no claimed speedup/promoted fast route. MEMORY_ONLY reported separately.
route_gate.scope_of_qualification: bounded fixed points/short trajectories only; not full1000 trajectory bitwise proof
